title: Democratic Quality Scorecard: National Universal Free Healthcare and Medical Integrity Bill, 2026

dimensions.evidence: Establishes universal statutory right to free healthcare and medicines; embeds companion Article 21B amendment draft.
dimensions.corrective_action: Statutory National Universal Health Trust Fund financed by dedicated health cess.

dimensions.evidence: Eliminates economic discrimination; mandates 15km urban and 30km rural public infrastructure radius density.
dimensions.uncertainty: Implementation timeline in remote tribal regions.
dimensions.corrective_action: Central financial assistance and mobile diagnostic units for lagging districts.

dimensions.evidence: Independent Medical Review Boards, National Healthcare Tariff Authority, and criminalization of doctor kickbacks.
dimensions.uncertainty: Potential resistance from commercial hospital lobbies.
dimensions.corrective_action: Strict judicial review, transparent public cost hearings, and whistleblower protections.

dimensions.evidence: Power divided across separate authorities for administration (NUHA), tariffs (NHTA), clinical audits (IMRC), data privacy (NMRPA), and funding (NUHTF).
dimensions.corrective_action: Joint Parliamentary Committee annual reporting and clear statutory jurisdictions.

dimensions.evidence: Mandatory publication of private price ceilings, generic prescribing rules, and open GIS infrastructure mapping.
dimensions.uncertainty: Data latency in rural health centre logging.
dimensions.corrective_action: Real-time digital sync via National Health Portal.

dimensions.evidence: Cognizable offences under BNS for kickbacks and unauthorized antimicrobial sales; civil penalties for private overcharging.
dimensions.corrective_action: Designated special health rights courts and time-bound summary trials.

dimensions.evidence: Plain-language summaries in 22 languages, screen-reader PDF, toll-free grievance helpline.
dimensions.corrective_action: Audio podcasts and community health worker outreach.

dimensions.evidence: 60-day nationwide consultation, lobbying transparency register, district town-halls, public redline outcome matrix.
dimensions.corrective_action: Automated NLP analysis paired with independent advisory panel review.
